title: गोवर्धन पर्वत को श्राप किसने दिया? | Pulastya's Curse #shorts
sources: Garga Samhita, Vrindavana Khanda, chapter 2, 'Description of Giriraja Govardhana's Birth' (wisdomlib.org, Garga Samhita English, verses 2.2.17-50): Govardhana, son of Mount Drona, is seen by the sage Pulastya, who asks Drona for his son to take to Kashi; Govardhana agrees on the condition that wherever he is set down he will stay; over Vraja he grows heavy, is set down and will not rise; Pulastya curses him to diminish every day by the measure of a sesame seed
Bhagavata Purana, Canto 10, chapters 24-25: Krishna lifts Govardhana for seven days to shelter Vraja from Indra's rain (Govardhan Puja)
Govardhan Hill, Mathura (Braj tradition): the parikrama around the hill is about 21 km
